answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 484 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sparrow. The plume index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the haven queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 323 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
